sentences.en: He enlightened me on how I should attack the subject.
sentences.zh: 他给我讲解了应该如何攻克这个课题。

sentences.en: Any society not enlightened by philosophers is fooled by quacks.
sentences.zh: 任何没有被哲学家开导的社会都被江湖骗子愚弄了。

sentences.en: Television enlightens the viewers as well as entertains them.
sentences.zh: 电视既娱乐观众也启发他们。

senses.zh: 启发，开导，教导，授予…知识
使知道，启发：inform, instruct；（在道德或精神上）进行教育：provide moral understanding
